name: Power milestones at four U.S. gigawatt data center developments
description: Seven dated developer and utility records covering energized buildings, planned grid capacity, onsite generation design, critical IT load, and regulatory approval at projects in Texas and Louisiana.
readingNotes: Each record represents the scope of a particular dated announcement. A later announcement can revise an earlier milestone.
Capacity figures use the basis stated in each record. Do not sum rows across phases, projects or measurement boundaries.
A null capacity means the cited record gives no applicable MW figure. These are project references and do not describe inventory available to a buyer.

sources.title: Crusoe announces flagship Abilene data center is live
Crusoe announces a new 900 MW campus next to the original Abilene campus
Crusoe and Lancium announce a 1 GW campus in Childress
Meta announces an expansion of its Richland Parish data center
Entergy reports regulatory approval for infrastructure serving Meta’s Louisiana campus

records.capacityBasis: Two buildings rated at 100 MW each
records.scope: Crusoe reported the first two buildings energized. 200 MW is their combined rating. The sources give no meter reading or spare tenant capacity.

records.capacityBasis: Total power capacity for the original campus
records.scope: The March 2026 announcement targeted completion of the second phase by year-end 2026. This is the campus total inclusive of the first two buildings.
The figure describes the planned plant for a separate campus next to the original Abilene development. The release gives no net output at the customer meter under design-day conditions.

records.capacityBasis: Two buildings designed for 336 MW of critical IT load each
records.scope: Calculated as 2 × 336 MW. The same campus appears in the generation record. These are different measurements of one development and cannot be added.
The project announcement describes a 270-acre campus. It does not report the first block of energized load.
The figure is Meta’s announced target in July 2026. The announcement does not give metered utility capacity or a phased service schedule.

records.milestone: Utility reports regulatory approval for new generation and transmission
records.scope: Entergy’s August 2025 release anticipated two Richland Parish plants in late 2028 and a Waterford plant by the end of 2029. These were utility project targets when announced. The release gives no MW allocation at the campus meter.
